docs.title: Context and Problem Statement
docs.text: We need a standard way to document architectural decisions for our bioinformatics API so new contributors understand our design choices without relying on tribal knowledge.

docs.title: Decision Outcome
docs.text: Chosen option: "Use Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)", because it is a proven standard in the open-source community. We will store these in docs/adr/.
